{'content': '傳奇平面設計師 Susan Kare 早前在 Startup School 2026 活動上發表演講，其演講影片已上載到 Y Combinator 的 YouTube 頻道。你可以在下面觀看。', 'translation': "Legendary graphic designer Susan Kare recently delivered a talk at the Startup School 2026 event, and the video of her presentation has been uploaded to Y Combinator's YouTube channel. You can watch it below."}

{'content': 'Susan Kare 分享了精彩的故事與設計智慧', 'translation': 'Susan Kare shared wonderful stories and design insights'}

{'content': '距離初代 Macintosh 推出至今已超過 40 年，然而該系統的圖像、字型、圖示以及整體 UI 元素，至今看起來仍與當年一樣吸引眼球。', 'translation': "More than 40 years have passed since the original Macintosh was released, yet the system's graphics, fonts, icons, and overall UI elements still look just as eye-catching today as they did back then."}

{'content': '事實上，Susan Kare 為初代 Macintosh 設計的許多元素，至今仍然是 macOS 的一部分，無論在精神上還是原始形態上都保留着。從 Command 鍵符號、Happy Mac 開機圖示、系統字型，到手形游標，Kare 的作品不僅塑造了 Mac 的視覺語言，更影響了整個個人電腦產業。', 'translation': "In fact, many of the elements Susan Kare designed for the original Macintosh remain part of macOS to this day, preserved both in spirit and in their original form. From the Command key symbol, the Happy Mac startup icon, and the system fonts, to the hand-shaped cursor, Kare's work not only shaped the visual language of the Mac, but also influenced the entire personal computer industry."}

{'content': '雖然任何研究過蘋果歷史的人，可能都看過 Kare 的草圖，甚至讀過或聽過她談論那段早期工作的訪問，但親耳聽她親身講述當年圖形使用者介面和點陣圖影像仍是未知領域時所懷抱的熱情與挫折，仍然非常有意思。', 'translation': "Although anyone who has studied Apple's history may have seen Kare's sketches, or even read or heard her interviews discussing that early work, it's still very interesting to hear her speak firsthand about the passion and frustration she felt back when graphical user interfaces and bitmap images were still uncharted territory."}

{'content': '因此，如果你對設計感興趣、對蘋果的歷史有興趣，或喜歡從專業角度聆聽有人分享其一生的熱情，Kare 的演講絕對不容錯過。', 'translation': "So, if you're interested in design, fascinated by Apple's history, or enjoy listening to someone share a lifelong passion from a professional perspective, Kare's talk is absolutely not to be missed."}

{'content': '除了詳細講述她在蘋果的工作之外，Kare 也談到了她是如何加入這間公司的，展示了她離開後的作品，分享了一些早期蘋果的軼事，並引用了其他傳奇設計師的話，為聽眾帶來額外的啟發。', 'translation': 'In addition to detailing her work at Apple, Kare also talked about how she joined the company, showcased her work after she left, shared some early Apple anecdotes, and quoted other legendary designers, bringing extra inspiration to the audience.'}
